profiles.hardware: Device contract, including physical evidence and declared feature behavior
profiles.korg-compatible: Hardware contract plus optional published Korg behavior compatibility
profiles.software: Bounded candidate execution against the documented emulator interface; excludes physical/electrical certification
profiles.application-only: Strict application-only acceptance: software profile plus pinned recovery policy, preserved recovery bytes and bounded installation/runtime evidence; missing evidence is rejection

requirements.title: Container
requirements.shall: Use one 256-byte VSB header and a 0x38000-byte full system payload.
requirements.verification: Executed by sq64_spec.image.inspect; corrupt-field negative fixtures cover each check.

requirements.title: Target identity
requirements.shall: Identify SQ-64 SYSTEM block zero, product ID 00 01 60, and member FF.
requirements.verification: Executed by sq64_spec.image.inspect; corrupt-field negative fixtures cover each check.

requirements.title: Geometry
requirements.shall: Use base zero, start zero, and total and payload length 0x38000.
requirements.verification: Executed by sq64_spec.image.inspect; corrupt-field negative fixtures cover each check.

requirements.title: Version encoding
requirements.shall: Use major <64, minor <128 and delay <=60000 ms or FFFFFFFF.
requirements.verification: Executed by sq64_spec.image.inspect; corrupt-field negative fixtures cover each check.

requirements.title: Payload checksums
requirements.shall: Make each documented checksum region sum to zero modulo 65536.
requirements.verification: Executed by sq64_spec.image.inspect; corrupt-field negative fixtures cover each check.

requirements.title: Initial stack
requirements.shall: Place the eight-byte-aligned initial stack within 0x20000000..0x20040000, excluding the lower bound.
requirements.verification: Executed by sq64_spec.image.inspect; corrupt-field negative fixtures cover each check.

requirements.title: Reset vector
requirements.shall: Provide a Thumb reset vector in loaded internal flash.
requirements.verification: Executed by sq64_spec.image.inspect; corrupt-field negative fixtures cover each check.

requirements.title: Cold startup
requirements.shall: Initialize every RAM value read before first assignment and reach an observable ready state from cold reset.
requirements.verification: Cold boot twice with RAM filled with 00, FF and deterministic random bytes; compare declared ready condition.

requirements.title: Startup modes
requirements.shall: Interpret GLOBAL held at power-on as version mode and GLOBAL+PATTERN as update mode.
requirements.verification: Boot using held panel signals, then release; verify version and updater discovery on candidate execution.

requirements.title: Reboot persistence
requirements.shall: Retain committed user data over normal software and power-button restart.
requirements.verification: Save distinct values, restart twice, export and compare logical data.

requirements.title: Fault behavior
requirements.shall: Report unrecoverable faults without continuing uncontrolled output or corrupting persistent data.
requirements.verification: Inject invalid vectors and unaligned multiword access in original diagnostic builds; expect explicit failure.

requirements.title: Power sources
requirements.shall: Start and operate with each supported power source.
requirements.verification: Physical USB-power and external-adapter cold-start trials with candidate hashes recorded.

requirements.title: Alignment
requirements.shall: Honor architectural alignment requirements for stack, exception frames and multiword/FP transfers.
requirements.verification: Directed aligned/misaligned scalar, LDM/STM, LDRD/STRD and FP cases; no model bypass.

requirements.title: Interrupt masking
requirements.shall: Honor PRIMASK, BASEPRI, FAULTMASK, NVIC enable and priorities.
requirements.verification: Pending interrupts across mask transitions and nested higher/lower-priority delivery.

requirements.title: Exception context
requirements.shall: Preserve architectural integer, stack, status and active floating-point state through interrupts.
requirements.verification: Preempt thread/handler on MSP/PSP, including IT slots, nested IRQs, eager and lazy FP.

requirements.title: Memory bounds
requirements.shall: Keep code, data, stack and DMA accesses within the image and board memory contracts.
requirements.verification: Guard every mapped boundary; stress maximum queues and stack depth under simultaneous events.

requirements.title: Concurrency
requirements.shall: Preserve storage, MIDI and control invariants under racing interrupt and DMA schedules.
requirements.verification: Replay deterministic varied interleavings; retain every counterexample and its seed.

requirements.title: Buttons
requirements.shall: Read each supported physical button independently without aliasing another control.
requirements.verification: Exercise 64 pads, 21 named buttons, release, hold, simultaneous presses and repeated transitions.

requirements.title: Encoders
requirements.shall: Read six encoders with both directions and bounded burst rates.
requirements.verification: One detent each way, wrap, acceleration and bursts; compare physical and modeled input events.

requirements.title: LEDs
requirements.shall: Drive each physical indicator within the board signaling contract.
requirements.verification: One indicator at a time and all indicators; inspect row multiplexing and physical output.

requirements.title: Display
requirements.shall: Write display commands and frame data within controller and DMA limits.
requirements.verification: Blank, all-on, checkerboard, edge pixels, frame refresh and custom menu drawing from candidate data.

requirements.title: Input under load
requirements.shall: Continue servicing controls while sequencing, receiving MIDI and saving.
requirements.verification: Deterministic combined workload; no stuck press or silently lost release.

requirements.title: Enumeration
requirements.shall: Enumerate as the declared USB MIDI interfaces and cable routing.
requirements.verification: Enumerate host descriptors, inspect endpoint types/lengths and probe each cable on physical hardware.

requirements.title: Channel messages
requirements.shall: Parse declared MIDI channel messages without buffer overrun or stuck notes.
requirements.verification: All status/channel values, two/three-byte messages, all data bytes, running status, truncation and saturation.

requirements.title: Realtime interleaving
requirements.shall: Handle realtime bytes inserted inside other MIDI messages and SysEx.
requirements.verification: Insert clock/start/continue/stop at every boundary; verify parser state remains valid.

requirements.title: SysEx framing
requirements.shall: Bound SysEx buffers and reject malformed framing or incorrect product routing.
requirements.verification: Wrong IDs, incomplete groups, excessive lengths, timeout, nested F0 and recovery to next valid frame.

requirements.title: USB packetization
requirements.shall: Handle MIDI event packets and short USB transfers correctly.
requirements.verification: Every supported CIN, all final SysEx group sizes, cable indices, 0/4/64-byte transfers and invalid sizes.

requirements.title: DIN transport
requirements.shall: Maintain correct MIDI DIN framing and supported receive/transmit behavior.
requirements.verification: Loopback and independent receiver trials at 31250 baud, including two outputs and receive overrun.

requirements.title: Isolation
requirements.shall: Prevent one MIDI cable or physical port from corrupting another port state.
requirements.verification: Interleave distinct streams on every available logical and physical port.

requirements.title: Internal clock
requirements.shall: Meet the timing and jitter limits declared by the selected sequencing profile.
requirements.verification: Measure output intervals with independent capture; declare tempo, load, tolerance and sample count.

requirements.title: External clock
requirements.shall: Handle declared sync/MIDI clock ratios, missing pulses and wraparound.
requirements.verification: First pulse, rate changes, missing/extra pulses, timestamp wrap and maximum supported rate.

requirements.title: Transport
requirements.shall: Handle start, stop and continue without unintended lingering outputs.
requirements.verification: Repeated transitions at step boundaries and during note/gate activity.

requirements.title: Scheduling
requirements.shall: Satisfy declared output deadlines during concurrent storage, display and USB traffic.
requirements.verification: Independent timing capture under worst documented simultaneous workload; software ticks alone do not pass.

requirements.title: CV range
requirements.shall: Keep pitch/modulation outputs within the supported configured voltage range.
requirements.verification: Physical measurements at minimum, midpoint and maximum with declared calibration and equipment.

requirements.title: Gate polarity
requirements.shall: Apply selected gate/trigger polarity and configured inactive state.
requirements.verification: Verify every gate/trigger jack in each declared polarity and during reset, stop and error.

requirements.title: Calibration
requirements.shall: Preserve device-specific calibration data and use the declared conversion contract.
requirements.verification: Before/after hashes of protected storage plus measured conversion at documented test points.

requirements.title: Pin configuration
requirements.shall: Avoid conflicting peripheral assignments and unsupported electrical drive modes.
requirements.verification: Review GPIO configuration against board evidence; verify physical output behavior.

requirements.title: Sequencer semantics
requirements.shall: Meet the behavior and boundaries of the firmware's declared sequencing profile.
requirements.verification: Custom firmware supplies explicit feature profile; Korg-compatible profile adds stock-semantic tests.

requirements.title: Address ownership
requirements.shall: Write only declared user-data or firmware regions and preserve reserved/device-specific regions.
requirements.verification: Trace all erase/program commands and compare guard regions before and after.

requirements.title: Flash semantics
requirements.shall: Respect erase geometry, write enable, page limits and zero-to-one restrictions.
requirements.verification: Boundary and cross-page writes, disabled writes, busy status, sector ends and malformed requests.

requirements.title: Save and load
requirements.shall: Restore complete committed projects and settings without cross-slot contamination.
requirements.verification: Exercise every project/control/scale slot with distinct synthetic data and normal restart.

requirements.title: Interrupted data save
requirements.shall: Define and meet a recoverable outcome for interrupted project/settings saves.
requirements.verification: Interrupt each save phase in software; require previous or new valid state, or documented explicit recovery.

requirements.title: Input validation
requirements.shall: Reject or safely represent malformed imported data without memory corruption.
requirements.verification: Every field boundary, cross-field invalid combination, truncated dump and inconsistent presence map.

requirements.title: Migration
requirements.shall: Handle declared older/newer data formats without silent destructive conversion.
requirements.verification: Round-trip supported formats; explicitly reject unsupported versions before writing.

requirements.title: Wear behavior
requirements.shall: Bound redundant erase/program operations for repeated unchanged settings.
requirements.verification: Trace operation counts under repeated edits/saves and compare declared endurance policy.

requirements.title: Create project
requirements.shall: Provide a documented operation that creates a new project with the declared default state in the current workspace without modifying any saved project slot.
requirements.verification: Create new projects over empty and fully populated catalogs; compare the exported workspace against declared defaults and digest-compare all 64 saved slots before and after.

requirements.title: Load project
requirements.shall: Load any saved project slot into the current workspace exactly as committed, and report an empty or invalid slot without changing the workspace.
requirements.verification: Load every populated slot holding distinct synthetic data and compare exported workspace bytes; attempt empty and corrupted slots, requiring an explicit report and an unchanged workspace.

requirements.title: Save project
requirements.shall: Save the current workspace to any selected project slot only through an explicit documented operation, modify only that slot, and report completion only after the data is committed.
requirements.verification: Save distinct data to first, middle and last slots and over an existing project; digest-compare untouched slots and read back after normal shutdown and cold restart.

requirements.title: Delete project
requirements.shall: Delete any saved project slot only through an explicit documented operation, leave the slot observably empty, and preserve every other slot, the current workspace and settings.
requirements.verification: Delete populated first, middle and last slots and verify emptiness by load attempt and export after restart; repeat deletion of an empty slot; interrupt delete phases in software, requiring the previous project or a valid empty slot; digest-compare remaining slots, workspace and settings.

requirements.title: Global settings mode
requirements.shall: Enter a documented global settings mode from the GLOBAL key during normal operation and leave it, with browsing alone changing no workspace, saved-slot or committed-settings data.
requirements.verification: Enter and exit global mode while stopped and while sequencing, browse every settings page without committing, and digest-compare the exported workspace, all 64 saved slots and the global record.

requirements.title: Edit global settings
requirements.shall: Allow editing every supported global setting, apply committed edits to device behavior and the exported global record, and preserve them over normal shutdown and cold restart without changing project, control or scale data.
requirements.verification: Edit each documented global field at its boundary values, compare the exported global record, observe a behavioral effect for each functional field, read back after normal shutdown and cold restart, and digest-compare projects, controls and scales.

requirements.title: Pattern selection
requirements.shall: Select any of the 16 patterns of each of the four tracks as the track's active pattern through a documented operation from the PATTERN key, and make the active selection observable.
requirements.verification: Select every pattern slot on every track holding distinct synthetic data; confirm the reported selection and that sequencing and export follow the selected pattern.

requirements.title: Pattern integrity
requirements.shall: Preserve every non-selected pattern across selection changes and edits, and keep each project's pattern presence map consistent with its stored patterns.
requirements.verification: Fill all 64 patterns with distinct synthetic data, switch and edit repeatedly, digest-compare non-selected patterns, and compare presence bytes against stored pattern data after save and normal restart.

requirements.title: Shift-modified functions
requirements.shall: Treat SHIFT as a modifier only: declare every supported SHIFT-modified function or mode, perform each declared function only while SHIFT is held with its companion control, and cause no state change from SHIFT alone or from undeclared combinations.
requirements.verification: Exercise every declared SHIFT combination with press/release ordering variants, then SHIFT alone and undeclared combinations with explicit no-effect expectations; digest-compare the workspace, saved slots and settings afterward. A candidate declaring no SHIFT functions still requires the no-effect cases.

requirements.title: Discovery
requirements.shall: Report a supported protocol and nonzero packet size, with truthful capabilities.
requirements.verification: Search/version requests in update mode on cold boot and after an update.

requirements.title: Begin validation
requirements.shall: Reject wrong targets, invalid geometry and unsupported packet sizes before programming.
requirements.verification: Malformed begin matrix and boundary lengths; inspect flash before and after rejection.

requirements.title: Packing
requirements.shall: Use canonical seven-bit MIDI packing and encoded-payload additive checksums.
requirements.verification: All input byte values and all partial groups; injected mask/checksum faults must fail.

requirements.title: Transfer order
requirements.shall: Acknowledge each accepted packet and reject invalid order without committing unrelated data.
requirements.verification: Executed transcript validator plus candidate receiver tests for duplicates, gaps and NAK behavior.

requirements.title: Completion
requirements.shall: Distinguish packet receipt, programming completion and successful restart.
requirements.verification: Complete update in emulation and hardware; verify display completion and post-reboot identity.

requirements.title: Interrupted transfer
requirements.shall: Define behavior for host disconnect or timeout at each transfer phase.
requirements.verification: Stop host traffic at each boundary; verify declared response and retained data without blind retry.

requirements.title: Future updates
requirements.shall: Retain a working documented method to install a subsequent firmware image.
requirements.verification: Candidate-to-candidate or candidate-to-approved-restore update, then cold boot.

requirements.title: Flash power loss scope
requirements.shall: Document that power loss during internal-flash programming is not guaranteed recoverable under this profile.
requirements.verification: Documentation check; deliberate physical power cuts during internal flash programming are excluded.

requirements.title: Coverage
requirements.shall: List every included user-data category and explicitly list exclusions.
requirements.verification: Check 64 saved project slots, current edit buffer, pattern presence, controls, scales and global settings.

requirements.title: Project sessions
requirements.shall: Transfer project headers and present patterns in a bounded session and finalize it.
requirements.verification: Normal, empty, partial and interrupted project sessions; no incomplete archive may be labeled complete.

requirements.title: Integrity
requirements.shall: Bind each backup record to its type, slot, length, canonical encoding and digest.
requirements.verification: Wrong slot, wrong type, altered payload, duplicate/missing pattern and oversized archive tests.

requirements.title: Restoration
requirements.shall: Restore included data and verify it through independent readback and normal restart.
requirements.verification: Compare all included logical bytes after write, restart and export; preserve intentionally excluded slots.

requirements.title: Boundary coverage
requirements.shall: Exercise valid extremes and invalid adjacent values for each public input field.
requirements.verification: Versioned field inventory, partitioned tests and deterministic fuzz seeds.

requirements.title: Resource limits
requirements.shall: Remain within declared stack, RAM, queues and storage budgets.
requirements.verification: High water marks under maximal simultaneous supported workload; detect guard violations.

requirements.title: Long run
requirements.shall: Meet declared sustained-operation behavior without accumulating corrupt state.
requirements.verification: Record duration, traffic and state checks; reproduce with instruction/event replay where applicable.

requirements.title: Evidence identity
requirements.shall: Bind every result to the exact candidate, tool versions, model profile and procedure.
requirements.verification: Reject stale hashes, unknown IDs and missing evidence; never convert not-run into pass.

requirements.title: Project layout
requirements.shall: Preserve the documented project and pattern data layouts.
requirements.verification: Round-trip all documented fields and reserved bytes; reference fixtures supplied locally only.

requirements.title: Global and controls
requirements.shall: Preserve documented global/control/scale serialization and supported settings.
requirements.verification: Boundary matrix for every field and slot.

requirements.title: Sequencing
requirements.shall: Match the declared Korg-compatible note, gate, modulation and probability semantics.
requirements.verification: Independent expected MIDI/CV event traces for every claimed feature; random seeds fixed.

requirements.title: Intentional deviations
requirements.shall: Declare each intentional compatibility deviation and its rationale.
requirements.verification: Expected-failure entries may not count as passes for a strict compatibility claim.

requirements.title: Preserved recovery image
requirements.shall: Preserve the entire first 64 KiB and all reviewed recovery code/data dependencies byte-for-byte against an explicitly approved baseline; identify the actual installed baseline by content, not a version string.
requirements.verification: Execute protected-image comparison with a reviewer-pinned policy; independently review dependency closure, including SPI-loaded code/data, vectors, startup, panel entry, USB, installer and RAM writer. Verify baseline content and approved installer/observer artifacts.

requirements.title: No recovery mutation
requirements.shall: Perform no erase or program attempts on protected recovery, reserved or calibration regions during installation or application execution, even if an operation would restore identical bytes or be rejected by hardware.
requirements.verification: Validate complete installation and runtime mutation captures. Review capture coverage of flash aliases, CPU, DMA, SPI commands and every programming path; before/after equality alone does not pass.

requirements.title: No irreversible configuration
requirements.shall: Never unlock or program option bytes, write OTP, change protection/boot/debug configuration, issue mass/chip erase or alter persistent flash status/security configuration in this profile.
requirements.verification: Reject every prohibited or unclassified persistent mutation attempt in both captures, and review instrumentation coverage of irreversible controls. Missing register/command modeling is rejection, not an ignored event.

requirements.title: Persistent write allowlist
requirements.shall: Restrict candidate changes and every persistent mutation to reviewed phase-specific application/user-data ranges, preserving all other storage; respect approved page and erase geometry.
requirements.verification: Validate non-overlapping policy ranges, protected-region exclusion, candidate destination changes, exact event ranges and geometry. A mutation crossing an allowlist boundary fails even if its start address is permitted. Installation traces must cover every changed payload byte.

requirements.title: Recovery before application
requirements.shall: Enter trusted recovery from the physical startup chord before executing custom application code, with the application absent, corrupt or immediately faulting; keep the recovery transport and approved restore operation usable.
requirements.verification: Cold boot using modeled or physical panel inputs, record execution ordering and restore traffic. Include a valid-checksum bad application, invalid vectors and corrupt application metadata; do not patch runtime state to force update mode.

requirements.title: Recovery after interrupted installation
requirements.shall: Preserve a usable trusted recovery path after interruption at every installation phase, without relying on the custom application or previously erased recovery dependencies.
requirements.verification: Use software fault injection before/after every persistent mutation and model partial erase/program, commit metadata and transport interruption. Prove recovery entry and a subsequent approved restore for each resulting state. Deliberate physical programming power cuts remain excluded; physical guarantees require separate evidence and enforcement.

releaseBlockers: Physical board pin assignments, display controller commands and exact MCU/flash parts require independent confirmation
Protected and calibration storage ownership requires independent confirmation
Electrical output ranges, calibration, clock accuracy and worst-case timing require measured acceptance bounds
Complete candidate-specific hardware campaigns remain required; bounded software compatibility does not certify hardware
